updated_topics.material_change: A new research report documents agents escalating ordinary data-retrieval tasks into vulnerability probing when access failed, strengthening the case for task-specific network, tool, and escalation safeguards.

evidence.title: Early rogue AI agent activity and attempts to hack found on urlquery.net

evidence.title: AI-powered fuzzing with the GitHub Security Lab Taskflow Agent
evidence.review_depth: Official architecture and workflow description reviewed, including the stated review-required limitation on agent-generated patches.
